Wolf's alert rules, rollups and satellite pushes are scheduled every minute. Frappe 15 and Dodock
tick every 4 minutes by default.

, an alert can come up to 4 minutes late, and "fire
after 3 evaluations" means 12 minutes. The Wolf UI's
page shows the pace in use.

is the operator UI, a Vue app built on frappe-ui. It reuses the Frappe
session: guests go to the login page, users without

get a 403.
Desk keeps the configuration DocTypes; a view the Wolf UI does not have yet links to Desk.
An incident in the Wolf UI
An incident: timeline, deployment marker, and the events grouped under it.
Desk and the Wolf UI show Wolf in each user's language (

). English and
French are available: field labels, descriptions, buttons, messages, the Wolf UI's pages and the
rule sentence. DocType names, event types, metric names and Select values stay in English, as in
the code. What Wolf stored when it happened stays in the language it was written in: incident
titles, event summaries, comments and the journal. Notifications and the SIEM export are in
English for now.

The Wolf site watches itself as soon as the app is installed: failed Scheduled Job Logs, Error Logs
and failed backups, failed desk logins, privileged logins from a new IP or country, role grants,
Email Queue backlogs and risky application changes. Each can be turned off in
